title: Sr. Director, Operations
text:
**About Schumacher**

Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the $150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers *"celebrate the feeling of home".* F. Schumacher & Co designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, rugs, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what's come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. F. Schumacher & Co is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our competitive advantage in the industry is our people. We believe that our employees are our most important assets. F. Schumacher & Co is deeply anchored in our company's core values which are as follows:

* Preserve our Start-up spirit

* Take Ownership & Accountability

* Be Solutions-Oriented

* Demonstrate Courage

* Practice Adaptability

* Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio. This role leads our **Paramount Handprints manufacturing operations** — our internal product mills based in Passaic, NJ and the Brooklyn Navy Yard — which are a critical differentiator for the business, providing craft and flexibility across our portfolio.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Sr. Director of Operations** to lead manufacturing operations across our two internal product mills: **one in Passaic, NJ** which produces hand screen-printed fabric and wallcoverings in Passaic, NJ, and another in the Brooklyn Navy Yard which prints digital wallcoverings, both for FS&CO and third-party customers. This individual will oversee the full manufacturing process — from receiving and inventory through order entry, craft printing, quality assurance, shipping and client communications.

This is a builder role. The ideal candidate is scrappy and entrepreneurial, comfortable operating in a hands-on, evolving environment, while also bringing rigor, standards, and consistency to a growing operation. They will balance our commitment to craftsmanship with the need for cost efficiency and anticipate that capabilities and capacity will continue to evolve over time.

This role is based full-time, on-site in Passaic, NJ, five days a week, with occasional travel to our Brooklyn Navy Yard and SoHo locations as needed. It reports to the **Head of Portfolio Development**.

 

**What You'll Do**

* **Leadership**: Lead a team of approximately 60 across both mills.

* Directly manage the Director of Production Planning, Director of Production, Shipping & Warehouse Leads, and Senior Digital Printers at each site and indirectly oversee their teams.

* Oversee the CX leader responsible for order entry and client communication.

* Build a strong, accountable culture across both sites; recruit, develop, and retain talent at all levels.

* **Manufacturing Operations**: Oversee the end-to-end manufacturing process and P&L ownership across both sites, including:

* Warehouse receiving and inventory management

* Screen engraving, color mixing, and trialing

* Production

* Quality assurance and printing

* Cutting, packing, and shipping

* **Process improvement & margin management**: Bring consistency and standardization reliability to our operations.

* Balance craftsmanship with efficiency to protect and improve margin across the mills' output

* Identify and implement process improvements that increase throughput, quality, and reliability without compromising craft.

* Develop and manage spending against budget, in conjunction with Head of Portfolio Development

* Identify cost savings opportunities across from raw materials, vendor contracts and labor

* Develop and track KPIs across capacity, production, quality, fulfillment & financial efficiency

* **Facilities, Safety & Space Planning**

* Own facilities, maintenance, and safety programs across both mills.

* Lead space planning as capacity and capabilities evolve over time.

* Identify opportunities to augment capabilities with equipment & CAPEX investment opportunities

* **Collaboration & Communication**: Serve as an internal partner and external-facing representative of the mills, building trust with cross-functional teams as well as third-party customers and vendors.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and vendors, including third-party manufacturing and supply partners; quickly step into and manage existing external relationships as you transition into the role.

* Partner proactively with Portfolio Development, Design, Procurement, Sales and other cross-functional teams to align capacity and capabilities with business needs.

* Provide proactive, transparent communication and reporting to the Head of Portfolio Development and cross-functional stakeholders

 

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations leadership, ideally in a craft, custom, or make-to-order production environment.

* Ability to consistently balance productivity, quality, and craftsmanship at the highest level.

* Proven experience managing large teams (50+) across multiple functions and/or sites.

* Strong track record in process improvement and bringing standards/consistency to an evolving operation.

* Strong proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

* Excellent people management skills with a demonstrated ability to build culture and develop talent.

* Scrappy, entrepreneurial, and hands-on, balanced with the ability to bring structure and rigor; comfort operating in a business where capabilities and capacity frequently evolve

* Experience with facilities, safety, and space planning oversight.

* On-site, full-time presence in Passaic, NJ required, five days a week, with occasional travel to Brooklyn and SoHo.

* Experience with ERP or production planning software.

* Experience owning a P&L or facility-level cost-center budget.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in screenprinting, digital printing, or textile/wallcovering manufacturing or adjacent industries.

* OSHA or manufacturing safety certification/experience.

* Bilingual (Spanish)

* Change management experience professionalizing a founder-led or informal operation.

**Benefits Package**

Your well-being is our top priority. Our benefits and total compensation are designed for the whole person, caring for both you and your family.

**Wealth Benefits:**

* Competitive Salary

* Corporate Annual Profit Sharing

* 401K Plan

**Health Benefits:**

* Dental Coverage

* Medical Coverage

* Prescription Drug Plan

* Vision Coverage

* Health Savings Account (HSA)

* TELADOC

**Other Benefits:**

* 20 Days Paid Time Off (PTO)

* 10 Company Holidays

* Bereavement Leave

* Life Insurance

* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

* AFLAC Plans (Accident and Critical Illness Plans)

* Pet Insurance

* Short-Term Disability (STD)

* Long Term Disability (LTD)

* Parental Medical Leave

* Child Bonding Leave

* Employee Discount

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and equality in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical and mental disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/assignment, citizenship, pregnancy or maternity, protected veteran status, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.
